{{Quote|Listen: Wedge and I can get aboard... Maybe arrange to be captured... and we'll slice into their data core and bug their communications systems. Instead of turning our own fleet inside out looking for the mole, we'll see who Bircher's talking to from ''his'' end.|[[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], to [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]]|<ref name="Star Wars 7" />}}
The '''infiltration of the ''Devastator''''' was a mission undertaken by [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]], [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Prithi]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].
